text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having brought down the supreme commander 
of Japan, Nakayama Festa holds high her 
banner of victory and throws down the 
gauntlet to El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's declaration is no longer 
mere bluster. Nakayama Festa poses a 
question to the spectators clinging to 
dreams of the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If an Umamusume appears who can surpass 
El Condor Pasa... Don't you dream of the 
hope that we could conquer the world?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd rejoiced at her declaration, 
finding hope in it. All of Japan shared 
the dream of taking on the world, looking 
forward to their battleground at the Japan 
Cup.
